description: Lists orders from all (or selected) connections for a local day, last N days, or an explicit range, normalized and de-duplicated: orders imported from another platform are flagged with `duplicate` (status "confirmed" = same sale proven by ids, "potential" = unproven). Personal data is masked unless includePersonalData=true. `complete` is false if any connection failed or results were truncated.

connectionIds.description: Connection ids to include (see commerce_list_connections). Omit for all connections.

date.description: A single local calendar day, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit with no other range = today so far.

days.description: Last N local days including today so far.

includePersonalData.description: Return buyer names, e-mails and phone numbers. Off by default; only enable when the task truly needs personal data.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for day boundaries, e.g. Europe/Warsaw. Defaults to the server timezone.

name: commerce_list_orders
title: List orders across stores
